citations.B1: Not thread-safe: read-then-write on `count` races across threads
citations.B3: fix with a lock (or atomic increment) around the check-and-set
citations.B4: No time window: once `limit` is hit, user is blocked forever, never resets
citations.B5: Unbounded memory growth: `counts` never evicts entries
citations.B6: Not multi-worker safe: `counts` is per-process memory
citations.B7: No input validation: `user_id` unvalidated (None, wrong type usable as dict key)
